Buzzsprout-18322949.title: Update: Immigration Freeze Policy Creates Administrative Gridlock
Buzzsprout-18322949.description_html: Trump administration immigration restrictions enacted following a shooting incident involving an Afghan national, which includes a halt on processing all pending immigration applications from 19 "high-risk" countries. This policy, implemented via a USCIS memo, mandates a comprehensive re-review and potential re-interview of applicants from these nations who entered the U.S. after January 20, 2021, and also covers approved benefits and asylum claims.
